# engine


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

An embedding is the mean final hidden state over the clip, minus a fixed
“typical audio” vector (`models/embed_center.npy`), scaled to unit
length. Clips are padded up to a whole second because each length is its
own compiled graph (a cold compile takes about a minute). MAX is only
touched from one worker thread, so loading and every embed run there.
